proposed.threshold_mapping: Binary per check; pass = every check (43) scores 1. Any 0 below the cap -> next iteration; at cap -> needs_owner. Algebra never rejects.
proposed.k_x: k = 3 iteration bound (= cap); x = 10 (% of budget) discovery window; not a spend allowance.
proposed.separation: Maker deepseek (deepinfra) vs model evaluator glm (z-ai): different family and endpoint; re-read 2026-10-28T20:30:01Z (deepinfra/fp8 and z-ai/fp8, both max_tokens 131072). S1 script authored by the Orchestrator drafter; it is not the instrument runner (CL1-16).
proposed.ratified_note: ratified:true is the shape the opener requires; it is true in fact by Steve's approvals quoted in proposed.status (verbatim, with times and channel, in OWNER-APPROVAL-RECORD.md). The ledger approve events are written only when Steve approves the frozen bar digest.
proposed.cap_definition: The corpus vocabulary allows only generations|regenerations. Here one 'generation' = one E-DI iteration: a Maker turn whose output the Evaluator scores and the pass rule is applied to. Maker retries/attempts inside a turn (failed applies, malformed output, token errors) are not generations and are limited only by budget and time. A void evaluator batch does not consume a generation.
proposed.self_reference: This job's own calls go through the derived job-1 harness (base), its ledger lines through kit/custody_ledger.py @ 3df1ce5 (missing commands hand-appended and disclosed), its record through emit_custody.py @ 3df1ce5. tools/edi/ (code under test) is run only by S1 checks, including the F8d live check (<= US$0.07 per batch). Base has no plumbline_verify.py, so this job's own record is gated by the standard check.py at CL1 only; after merge the merged verifier is run once post hoc, non-gating, expected exit 4 (schema), result filed as an amendment.
proposed.held_out_controls: /workspace/job-controls/2026-10-28-custody-times-ledger-spend/ (new; sha256 manifest committed at freeze) + /workspace/next-job-controls/controls/ (prior job's, manifest 9764d8e4...60bf, for T6). Never in the repo or in Maker prompts.
proposed.maker_retries: limited by the money bound, the clock-time bound, and the tripwire (Owner standing rule 2026-10-28 15:52 EDT): the same failure class 3 times in a row within an iteration -> stop and report to the Orchestrator so the request can be changed; finish_reason=length with empty content is its own failure class (stop, do not retry); every attempt is logged with finish_reason. Several calls may make one iteration (e.g. one per part)
